decisions.statement: An add-on's own code is the module code beside the add-on's own pages.
An add-on still outside akasha keeps its code under a `src` folder.
A machine-written file is the add-on's own wherever the file sits.
A machine-written file counts even where a scan declines to read the file.
A type declaration is no code.
A file a build wrote is a copy of a file already counted.
A file another package owns is no part of the add-on.
Five checks each had a reading of their own before this module.

definition: which files under a game add-on's own folder are that add-on's source and markup
